Huéspedes menores de 18 años No se aceptan menores de 18 años en dormitorios compartidos. The historic centre of the city and Plaça Catalunya can be reached in around 10 minutes by train. Camp Nou, Plaça Espanya, Fira de Barcelona, Poble Espanyol, Palau Nacional, and CaixaForum are all just a 20-minute walk away. From the airport by public transport By train (RENFE) RENFE is fastest way to reach the hostel. Single ticket from airport to the Sants station costs 4.1€, alternatively you can use T10 or Hola BCN card. The train runs every 30 minutes (6:00-23:00) from T2 terminal. The name of the stop you want is Barcelona-Sants (3 stops, 20 minutes). The hostel is just in a 3 minute walk away from the station . By metro (TMB) You can take metro from both T1 and T2 terminals of Barcelona Airport. Single ticket costs 4.2€. Alternatively you can use Hola BCN card. The metro runs every 5-10 minutes (05:00-00:00). The name of the stop you want is Sants Estació (L5), it is located inside the Barcelona Sants station. The hostel is just in a 3 minute walk away from the station . By city bus If you arrive at the airport at midnight or later, during 23:30-5:30 night buses N16, N17 and N18 operate between airport and the city. Single ticket costs 2.15€, alternatively you can use T10 or Hola BCN card. The name of the stop you want is Plaça Espanya. The hostel is located within a 18 minute walk from Plaça Espanya . Español About Booking Gallery How to get to FAQ FAQ Answers to common questions When I can check-in and check-out? Check-in is from 2:00 pm till 11:00 pm. Check-out is until 11:00 am. Late check-ins are not accepted. Do you have luggage storage? Luggage storage is avaliable from 11:00 am on the arrival date and until 2:00 pm on the departure date. Do you need my ID/passport at check-in? Yes. All guests, including minors, are required to show an identity document with a photo (ID card or passport) upon check-in. What is your cancellation policy? If you made a Standard reservation, you can cancel free of charge until 2 days before your arrival date. Cancellations are only accepted by hello@meetingpointhostels.com e-mail . For Non-refundable reservations cancellations are not accepted under any circumstances. If you made booking through an external booking website or online travel agency, you need to contact them directly to cancel your reservation. Do I need valid credit/debit card for reservation? Yes, a valid credit/debit card is required to guarantee your reservation with us. If you made a Standard reservation, you will be charged a prepayment of the first night in 2 days before your arrival. For non-refundable reservations the full amount is charged in advance. Non-valid credit/debit cards will result in the cancellation of your reservation. What payment methods do you accept? We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard and Maestro). Can I change my booking? Send us hello@meetingpointhostels.com e-mail with your booking details and information about the modifications you need. We can change dates of your stay only if there are beds/rooms available on the required dates. Group booking (9 people or more) If you would like to make reservation for a group of 9 people or more, please, contact us by hello@meetingpointhostels.com e-mail . Group reservations are non refundable and require the full payment at least two weeks prior to arrival. Are people under 18 allowed in the hostel? Minors under 18 are not allowed to stay in shared dormitories. Minors under 18 can only stay in private rooms, if accompanied by their parents. Do you provide breakfasts? No, unfortunately, we don’t.
